passif.description:
Increases basic stats of [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] participating in battle by [FFAE00]15%[-] and decreases their [00D5FF]damage taken[-] by [FFAE00]50%[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Applicable Allies: Humans and [The Seven Deadly Sins][-][/i]

The hero gains [00D5FF]Craving[-] for [FFAE00]2 turns[-] at the start of the battle.
[i][C0C0C0]※Craving: Applicable Allies' HP-related stats [FFAE00]+20%[-].
Grants Applicable Allies immunity to Recovery-related stat restrictions.Applicable Allies immediately recover [FF8000]30%[-] of damage taken during the enemy's turn.
[FFAE00]40%[-] Damage Taken Suppression against single-target attacks (including counters).[-][/i]

When the hero uses a [00D5FF]Craving[-] skill on an enemy with [00D5FF]Mark of Craving[-], the [00D5FF]damage dealt[-] increases by [FFAE00]100%[-], and if damage is dealt, the hero steals [FFAE00]1 orb[-] of that enemy's Ultimate Move Gauge, then enters [00D5FF]Stealth[-] for [FFAE00]1 turn[-] and does not take [00D5FF]Reflect[-] or [00D5FF]Counter[-] damage.
[i][C0C0C0]※Mark of Craving: Damage dealt [FFAE00]-70%[-], damage taken [FFAE00]+70%[-].
※Stealth: Cannot be targeted while other allies remain.[-][/i]

For [FFAE00]each orb[-] of the Ultimate Move Gauge stolen, [00D5FF]Applicable Allies'[-] basic stats increase by [FFAE00]5%[-] and the hero's [00D5FF]Crit Damage[-] increases by [FFAE00]30%[-]. [FFAE00](10 times)[-]

When an [00D5FF]Applicable Ally's[-] skill doesn't result in a critical strike, it inflicts additional damage equal to [FF8000]40%[-] of the hero's increased HP.
